articles.summary: BRIDGEWATER N.J., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Legend Biotech Corporation (NASDAQ: LEGN) ( Legend Biotech), a global leader in cell therapy, will host a conference call for investors at 8:00 a.m. ET on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, to review second quarter 2026 financial results.
articles.title: Legend Biotech to Host Investor Conference Call on Second Quarter 2026 Results
